CFML Language Reference: Tags

CFTRANSACTION

Put CFQUERY tags between <CFTRANSACTION> and </CFTRANSACTION> when they belong together, such as debiting one account and crediting another. On a transactional driver the group is committed when the end tag is reached, or rolled back if an error occurs inside it.

Category

Database manipulation

Syntax

<CFTRANSACTION ACTION="BEGIN"
    ISOLATION="lock_level">
  CFQUERY tags
</CFTRANSACTION>

Attributes

ACTION
Optional, default "BEGIN". BEGIN, COMMIT or ROLLBACK. COMMIT and ROLLBACK are used in a nested CFTRANSACTION to end the current transaction early (ROLLBACK undoes everything written so far).
ISOLATION
Optional. ODBC lock level: READ_UNCOMMITTED, READ_COMMITTED, REPEATABLE_READ or SERIALIZABLE. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.

Usage

Note  The built-in flat-file driver has no transaction log, so KoldFusion snapshots the tables of each data source the first time a statement writes to it inside the transaction. If an error escapes the CFTRANSACTION block, or a nested <CFTRANSACTION ACTION="ROLLBACK"> runs, the snapshot is restored; otherwise the changes are kept when the end tag is reached. Other requests can see uncommitted changes (there is no isolation), so keep transactions short.

All queries inside one transaction must use the same data source. To keep two users from interleaving updates to shared variables (not tables), use CFLOCK.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<!--- Add a comment, look at it, take it back out again --->
<CFQUERY NAME="Before" DATASOURCE="cfsnippets">
SELECT COUNT(*) AS Total FROM Comments
</CFQUERY>

<CFTRANSACTION>
  <CFQUERY DATASOURCE="cfsnippets">
  INSERT INTO Comments (Email, FromUser, Subject, CommtType, MessText, Processed)
  VALUES ('ann@localhost', 'Ann Example', 'Transaction test', 'Question', 'Testing 1, 2, 3', 0)
  </CFQUERY>
  <CFQUERY NAME="During" DATASOURCE="cfsnippets">
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS Total, MAX(CommentID) AS LastID FROM Comments
  </CFQUERY>
  <CFQUERY DATASOURCE="cfsnippets">
  DELETE FROM Comments WHERE CommentID = #During.LastID#
  </CFQUERY>
</CFTRANSACTION>

<CFQUERY NAME="After" DATASOURCE="cfsnippets">
SELECT COUNT(*) AS Total FROM Comments
</CFQUERY>

<CFOUTPUT>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>Moment</TH><TH>Rows in Comments</TH></TR>
<TR><TD>Before the transaction</TD><TD>#Before.Total#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>After the INSERT (new ID #During.LastID#)</TD><TD>#During.Total#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>After the DELETE</TD><TD>#After.Total#</TD></TR>
</TABLE>
</CFOUTPUT>
